summary: Support system Python on self-hosted governance runners

delivery.outcome: Publish new-project 0.19.12 so managed governance uses pinned setup-python on GitHub-hosted runners and an already-provisioned system python3 on self-hosted runners.
nonGoals: Do not install or mutate host packages on self-hosted runners
Do not weaken or skip the governance gate
Do not move immutable release tags

architecture.decision: Use the trusted runner.environment boundary: keep pinned Python 3.11 provisioning on GitHub-hosted runners, while self-hosted runners must provide python3 and execute the same deterministic gate unchanged.
architecture.rollback: Publish a later corrective release; never move v0.19.12.

validation.evidence: Workflow contract asserts conditional hosted setup and self-hosted python3 preflight.

commands: for test_script in tests/*.test.sh; do bash "$test_script"; done
Adopt exact merged release in subactor/agents and observe governance / enforce
